name: Records of the Panama Canal (Record Group 185)
repository: United States National Archives, College Park, Maryland
holdings: ~9,240 cartographic items / 125 cubic feet on paper at College Park; Compagnie Universelle general and town-site maps 1881–97; Isthmian Canal Commission lock and dam plans, 1913 route plates; textual labor and administrative series; digitized: construction photographs (series 185-G), land and claims index cards

name: Canal Zone maps including the 1911 Property Map
repository: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division
holdings: Canal Zone sheets in the Geography and Map Division, including the 1911 Property Map; Culebra town masters 1905–10; 1908–09 canal surveys; 64 catalog records, all relevant sheets fetched

name: The Canal Record, digitized run
repository: University of Florida Smathers Libraries / Internet Archive
affiliation: United States official record (digitized at the University of Florida)
holdings: The Canal Record, official weekly of the Isthmian Canal Commission; 28 volumes 1907–41, full text online

name: Museo del Canal Interoceanico holdings
repository: Museo del Canal Interoceanico, Panama City
formats: Books, oral history, cartography, photographs, postcards, memorabilia
holdings: Books; cartography (4% of the reserve); photographs (3%); postcards and memorabilia; Archivo de Historia Oral (onsite only); catalog metadata online, no digital objects served
institution: Museo del Canal Interoceánico de Panamá

name: Silver Men consortium (United Nations (Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) Memory of the World)
repository: Jamaica, Barbados, Saint Lucia, the United Kingdom (Kew), the University of Florida
access: Remote: catalogues only; components not full-text online
affiliation: West Indian / Caribbean (part held at the United Kingdom's colonial archive at Kew)
holdings: Barbados: District A Emigrants Registers ×3, Savings Bank Registers 1853–1918 ×20, Official Gazettes; Jamaica: Colonial Secretary records on Panama, Jamaica Gazette 1905–15; Saint Lucia National Archives; Barbados Museum: Hutchinson postcards, Lady Carter Visitor Book; United Kingdom National Archives at Kew, Mallet family papers; none remotely searchable

name: czbrats community compilation
holdings: Web compilation of Zonian memory: village pages, photographs, town lists; lead-generator, corroborate elsewhere
institution: czbrats.com (website of former Canal Zone residents)

name: Smithsonian collections
access: Searchable in full text; partly online
holdings: 45,000 'Canal Zone' records, searchable in full text (National Museum of Natural History specimen localities); Fishbaugh photograph album (27 of 100 views digitized); 719 Panama Canal Company photonegatives, captions untranscribed; Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute map library, 1,000+ sheets, onsite only

name: Caribbean Newspaper Digital Library
repository: Digital Library of the Caribbean (University of Florida / Florida International University); Bridgetown, Nassau, Hamilton, Kingston presses
access: Digitized (open, remote, searchable in full text)
affiliation: Caribbean press (digitized at the University of Florida)
holdings: Caribbean presses 1880–1950 — Bridgetown, Kingston, Nassau, Hamilton; newspapers, serials, books; Isthmian Historical Society 'Silver People' competition letters, 1963; open and searchable in full text

name: Chronicling America digitized newspapers
repository: Library of Congress, Serial and Government Publications Division
access: Fully digitized (open in a browser; bulk downloads blocked)
affiliation: United States federal (digitized United States press)
holdings: Digitized United States and territorial newspapers; canal-era syndications including the Canal Record 'vanishing villages' notices; Saint Croix Avis French-era canal reports 1882–87; full text searchable; the searched window 1880–1920 spans the French era through construction

name: Internet Archive canal-era texts
holdings: 1,315 digitized canal-era volumes; annual reports, memoirs, guidebooks; ~72 map scans copied from other repositories

name: East Carolina University digital collections
repository: Joyner Library, East Carolina University, Greenville, North Carolina
holdings: Eastern Reflector and Daily Reflector newspaper runs; Navy oral histories; one 1927 Canal Zone map sheet (Robert Morgan Papers)

name: Perry-Castañeda Library map collection
holdings: 17 Canal Zone map sheets; Shepherd's Historical Atlas 1911 Panama Canal plate

name: Census enumeration-district maps (Record Group 29)
repository: United States National Archives, College Park, Maryland
holdings: 1940 census enumeration-district maps of the Canal Zone (series A3378); 1950 counterpart; late street-level views of the towns

name: David Rumsey map collection
repository: David Rumsey Map Center, Stanford University
affiliation: United States private map collection (Stanford University)
holdings: 7 Canal Zone map sheets, fetched at full resolution; used as georeferencing and tracing bases, not yet as attestation sources

name: Wikimedia Commons Canal Zone maps
affiliation: mirrored United States and European cartography (volunteer aggregator)
holdings: 87 Canal Zone map files; Lloyd 1830 charts; malaria and sanitation maps; a judicial-districts map mirrored from the United States National Archives; used as georeferencing and tracing bases, not yet as attestation sources

name: Gallica digital library (French canal-era material)
access: Fully digitized (open, remote, searchable in full text)
holdings: Boutan 1880: geological survey naming the whole village chain as canal-line stations; Verbrugghe 1879: narrative of the Wyse-Reclus route reconnaissance; Charles-Roux 1886: official French canal-progress report (Buhio-Soldado "un beau campement"); 23 canal-era maps (cartes), downloadable in full resolution, not yet consulted; searchable in full text remotely

name: La Estrella de Panamá, digitized newspaper run
repository: Library of Congress, Serial and Government Publications Division
digitization: Full (for the Library of Congress run)
affiliation: Panamanian press (digitized at the Library of Congress)
holdings: La Estrella de Panama, the Panamanian newspaper of record; digitized run 1849-current at the Library of Congress; searchable in full text; Spanish spellings need care, and names shared with other places more so

name: University of Florida digital map collections (including the Panama Canal Museum Collection)
repository: George A. Smathers Libraries, University of Florida, Gainesville
holdings: Maps from the former Panama Canal Museum, transferred to the University of Florida; 1845 Garella topographic map of the isthmus; 1947 Cristóbal–Colón–Mount Hope city sheet
